decisions.id: B3-1 modal depiction rounds g-j edits taken
decisions.summary: dispersed (one grove shape per settlement; no lanes a convention; channel off the nearest ditch, brook or a neighbor's channel, nearest a convention), nucleated (belt runs on past the map edge; a compact cluster, never a hollow arc; a village held to a least packing, a hamlet not), conifer_led (edge past the belt's inner side, front row whole), mixed_broadleaf (back grove band on the windward side, one or two sides; taken up again either side of a lane, its passage unrecorded), alder (sentence trimmed)
decisions.why: Each edit makes a modal say what the map draws and labels conventions and unrecorded facts as such. No research claim is rewritten to match a drift, and nothing the research requires is written out.

decisions.summary: depiction finding declined: the modal keeps 'smaller broadleaf crowns' because LESSER_BROADLEAF_S draws 0.75-0.85 of the mean radius
decisions.why: The modal describes what is drawn. The range sits inside 0080's 0.75-1.4 and its rows were closed E0 in wave 39 (overrides.json). No new carve-out is made here.

decisions.id: B3-3 mixed belt's wind side at the village tier not taken
decisions.summary: depiction finding declined: the village roller's belt side (RollVillageMixin._roll_windbreak) left to the deferred legacy tier
decisions.why: Amendment 8 (GM: limit to code run by magistracies, country shrines and scripted hamlets; legacy settlements DEFERRED) and spec line 155 already settle this. The hamlet modal names the declared wind side, which is what the hamlet code does. The decline is recorded only in commit a07691a48's message, though, and plan.md does not carry it.

decisions.summary: field_height_near in one vector pass; the privy's reach tested at its far corner alone; the bund run-on's clear prunes blocks by box
decisions.why: Each one gives the same answer: the five hamlets are byte-identical. The far-corner test is exact (each axis gap is largest at the far corner). The box prune pads by the stroke width and the fixture pad, and start lies on a-b, so it prunes nothing that could touch. This is VI's 'no good way around it' work, with no change to behavior.

decisions.id: B3-8 perf-audit: explanation CONSISTENT, audit cannot-determine
decisions.summary: dev/perf-log/20261008T234039Z audit: no_way_around 'not settled by the data' until a seating that keeps 0042/0047 and leaves no knot or stranded way is tried
decisions.why: The plan does not treat the inconclusive audit as passed. VI: an inconclusive verdict never lets the work proceed, and every rung keeps the ones below it, so the GM's band-3 sign-off stands above the audit and does not replace it. The batch table row 3 still reads 'perf-audit owed', which is stale.

decisions.id: B3-9 seed 25's 40-household refusal (T140) and the no-knot seating: one keep-out tried, the remaining route put to the GM
decisions.summary: the 'way out' strip (yard width, 20 ft) was tried and reverted because Inashiro refused its web; the plan then names 'the seating's own search asking the way out of each household with its fixtures in place (E3, row 748)' as the remaining route and puts it to the GM with the band-3 sign-off; T140 reads 'fix ... or the GM's waiver'
decisions.why: Seed 25 at 40 households drew at the batch's start and refuses now, so it is a regression (XIII: a cohort seed that passed and now fails; 'one seed' and 'a map nobody ships' excuse nothing). XIII allows a waiver to be asked 'only after the fix has been genuinely attempted', and a session that has found a path forward TAKES it. The plan names the path itself, the seating's own search, and has not tried it. The one trial was a local keep-out, a different mechanism. The perf-audit's no_way_around criterion names the same untried seating. This is the shape of W54-5 round 2 (row 748's re-lay named but not attempted: NOT LEGITIMATE), which the session then fixed with KNOTTED_TRIES. The hold is lawful, because T140 open keeps it off main. What is not lawful is handing the GM the choice of route. The GM's own instruction says to keep working until the cap or the end of the feature and to defer only real questions.
